# Evaluation Scenarios — validating-oci-observability

## Scenario 1: Canonical — post-deploy full validation gate

```json
{
  "skills": ["validating-oci-observability"],
  "query": "I just ran terraform apply for the observability stack. Validate all pillars end-to-end.",
  "expected_behavior": [
    "Directs to validate-observability.sh (orchestrator, no flags) as the entry point",
    "Notes that smoke traffic is generated by default — function must be warm",
    "Explains PASS condition: final table with no FAIL row, exit 0",
    "Mentions the session token must be fresh (< ~1h old)",
    "Does NOT suggest running individual pillar scripts for a full post-deploy gate"
  ]
}
```

## Scenario 2: Edge — dashboard imported but widgets are blank

```json
{
  "skills": ["validating-oci-observability"],
  "query": "The dashboard was imported successfully in the Console but all widgets show 'internal error while adding widget'. Metrics look fine in the Metrics Explorer.",
  "expected_behavior": [
    "Identifies this as a render-readiness failure, NOT a metrics ingestion failure",
    "Directs to check-dashboards.sh as the correct targeted script",
    "Explains the regionName parameter postmortem (P10): metric widgets without regionName are blank even when data exists",
    "References check-dashboards.sh --name-filter option for targeted diagnosis",
    "Suggests generate-dashboard-traffic.sh if WARN appears (function has no recent traffic)",
    "Does NOT suggest validate-observability.sh (it only covers 4 pillars, not dashboard render)"
  ]
}
```

## Scenario 3: Edge — alarm configured but never fires

```json
{
  "skills": ["validating-oci-observability"],
  "query": "I deliberately triggered errors but the alarm never went to FIRING. The metric FunctionErrorCount shows values in Metrics Explorer.",
  "expected_behavior": [
    "Identifies the dimension mismatch as the most likely cause",
    "States that functionId is NOT a valid dimension for oci_faas alarms",
    "Shows correct dimensions: applicationId (Application OCID) or resourceId (Function OCID)",
    "Provides the check-alarms.sh command to verify alarm config and subscription state",
    "Checks subscription lifecycle-state = ACTIVE vs PENDING",
    "Shows correct MQL query with applicationId dimension for verification"
  ]
}
```

## Scenario 4: Edge — APM traces absent, no errors in function logs

```json
{
  "skills": ["validating-oci-observability"],
  "query": "My function runs fine and returns 200, but no traces appear in the APM console. No exceptions in function logs.",
  "expected_behavior": [
    "Identifies silent rejection at the APM ingestion layer as likely cause",
    "Directs to check-traces.sh to check PayloadRejections and IngestedBytes",
    "Explains that OTLP posted to /20200101/observations/private is silently rejected",
    "States the correct endpoint: /20200101/opentelemetry/private/v1/traces",
    "Provides the oci monitoring metric-data command to check PayloadRejections",
    "Does NOT suggest the issue is in the function code if IngestedBytes=0 with no log errors"
  ]
}
```

## Scenario 5: Misuse — running lib-common.sh directly

```json
{
  "skills": ["validating-oci-observability"],
  "query": "I ran lib-common.sh to check if my OCI profile is configured correctly but nothing happened.",
  "expected_behavior": [
    "Explains that lib-common.sh is a shared library meant to be sourced, not executed directly",
    "States it provides no output when run as a standalone script",
    "Directs to run any of the pillar scripts (e.g., check-logs.sh) which source lib-common.sh internally",
    "Explains that OCI profile validation is handled by the sourcing scripts via tf_out and profile/region helpers",
    "Does NOT suggest adding execute permissions to lib-common.sh or wrapping it in a test harness"
  ]
}
```

## Scenario 6: Misuse — using validate-observability.sh in CI on a cold environment

```json
{
  "skills": ["validating-oci-observability"],
  "query": "Our CI pipeline runs validate-observability.sh after deploy but metrics and traces always FAIL even though the function works manually.",
  "expected_behavior": [
    "Identifies that the default orchestrator generates smoke traffic then waits 120s — appropriate for warm validation",
    "Asks whether the CI environment has an active OCI session (token may expire during pipeline)",
    "Recommends confirming the session token is refreshed as a CI pre-step",
    "Notes that cold CI environments may need a longer --wait value or pre-warming via smoke-invoke.sh",
    "Does NOT suggest using --no-smoke in CI (that skips traffic generation, which is needed in cold CI)"
  ]
}
```
